hypothesis: Medium-horizon GBPUSD breakouts can persist long enough that low turnover survives Ostium-compatible costs; direction asymmetry is evaluated explicitly.
data: Frozen GBPUSD M1 2007-2023 aggregated to complete UTC M15 bars
variants: 12 fixed variants: Donchian 96/192/384 bars x ATR stop 2/3 x long/short; exit channel is half the entry channel, EMA192 trend filter, maximum hold 960 bars
selection: Select one train winner independently for long and short; do not tune after validation/OOS
execution: Signal at M15 close, entry at next open; adverse intrabar stop precedence; channel exit at next open; 8/15/30 bps round-trip cost
sq_policy: Only a direction passing every frozen pre-holdout gate may receive a bounded SQ retest/optimization campaign.
holdout_policy: Do not evaluate during this screen.
